deviations_and_owner_decisions: 1. Backup source. D8 and the steps expected a verified backup on the backup drive E:. E:\JARVIS-BACKUP holds a file-by-file copy of the old project, not a JARVIS backup, and copy script v1 picked a report file (incident-01-backup-copy.json, addendum 1; run-1 record kept as backup-copy-run1-incident01.json). Owner decision 01 'A': a fresh backup from the everyday JARVIS. E: was read only by the owner's own command and is unchanged.

2. The everyday JARVIS cannot start (its Codex Python runtime is gone; incident-02-everyday-jarvis-cannot-start.json). Owner decision 02 'approved': the backup was made by the owner's command with the everyday JARVIS's own backup code run with FINAL's Python (New-OldJarvisBackup.ps1), then copied with Copy-BackupForGate18-v2.ps1. This wrote two new files (the backup and its test receipt) into the everyday JARVIS's jarvis-backups folder; nothing else there was changed.

3. Guest run 1 (incident-03-run1\gate18-20261004-065046) stopped at K2: the first install was running because its Startup shortcut starts JARVIS at sign-in and the steps lacked 'quit JARVIS first' (incident-03-k2-jarvis-running.json). Owner decision 03 'approve': the owner quit JARVIS in the VM; rerun.

4. Guest run 2 (incident-04-run2\gate18-20261004-072308) hung at K4: FINAL's recovery.verify() creates its temporary folder beside the archive and the archive was on the read-only disc (incident-04-k4-hang-read-only-disc.json). Owner decision 04 'approved': the owner closed the stuck window, copied the disc's six files to C:\g18 and ran the unchanged script from there with -RestoreHome C:\g18home. The restore therefore read the backup from a writable copy of the disc, proven equal by K1 and K9.

5. Left in the VM and in snapshot GATE18-PASS: an unused, verified third install at %LOCALAPPDATA%\JARVIS-restore from run 2 (no data imported), the folder C:\g18 (copy of the disc, including the backup) and the restore target C:\g18home with the owner's personal data.

6. All three guest runs happened in one VM session (one start, 06:47Z; shut down about 07:54Z). The clean repeat from snapshot GATE17-19-PASS foreseen in the steps was not used because the cause of run 1 would have repeated after a restore; the owner approved each rerun.
findings_for_gate_20: FINAL 1.0.11 limitation: verifying or importing a backup that lies on read-only media never returns (Python 3.12 tempfile retry loop on Windows) instead of failing with a message. Not relevant to a backup in a normal folder (the cutover case). Fix in the first release after cutover.

Observation, not a criterion: K6 reports memory_items_visible 3 from /api/state while the items table holds 6 rows; the script only records the number. To be explained (kinds of items shown in the state) before or at cutover, where the owner checks the memories by eye (cutover blueprint step 7).
The Gate 18 guest script and steps need 'quit JARVIS first' and 'restore from a writable copy' before any reuse; the built disc is evidence and is not changed.
Timings in the VM: second install about 3.5 min (K2 to K3), import 2.4 s, Core ready on the restored data 58.1 s, K8 verification of both installs about 53 s.
